name: volt-livestock-marketplace
description: VOLT: builds the React frontend into backend/frontend-build so the Express backend serves the whole site (one Node.js app; Hostinger deploys only backend/).

scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('backend/frontend-build',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('frontend/build','backend/frontend-build',{recursive:true})"
